span.p:
START · README.md + docs/architecture/
Understand runtime and choose one user action

div.style: color: rgb(36, 27, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1 · Read the contract
shared/message_types.py + validation.py
web/src/types.ts + docs/protocol.md

div.style: color: rgb(36, 27, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2 · Find the user action
web/src/App.tsx → ChatController in chat.ts

div.style: color: rgb(36, 27, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3 · Follow one request ID
Transport.request → /ws → decode_message
Router.dispatch in server/router.py

div.style: color: rgb(18, 49, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AUTH path
handlers/auth.py → passwords.py
rate_limit.py → sessions.py

div.style: color: rgb(18, 49, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ROOM / MESSAGE path
handlers/chat.py → database.py
publish_lock → registry.publish

div.style: color: rgb(18, 49, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
HISTORY / SEARCH path
handlers/history.py → search_messages
before_id + join visibility

div.style: color: rgb(18, 49, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
FILE path
chat.ts upload/download → files.py
Transfer → partial → commit

div.style: color: rgb(18, 49, 78) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AI path
handlers/ai.py → worker _run
ai_service.py → HTTPS provider

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

permissions.py → schema.sql → database.py

connection.enqueue → WebConnection.run
Transport.onmessage → controller → React

web/e2e/*.spec.ts
